label: Depot

example.title: Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Railroad Depot

brief: Long one-storey red-brick combination depot under a steep slate-look hipped roof with wide bracketed eaves over the platform. Each gable end and a trackside cross-gable carry big round-arched lunette windows with brick arches and a stone sill band; a projecting operator's bay faces the rails. The lower frame freight-house wing continues the line at one end; brick platform with baggage carts and a telegraph pole.
